description: Full live snapshot of one market: both sides' bid and ask, spread, status and close time. Takes a Kalshi ticker or an instrument id (ins_...) and returns both ids when Arena has the instrument; with an instrument, buy_for_yes and buy_for_no say which side of the ticker holds each side of it. Pass contracts to get the exact stake the engine will charge, plus an estimated venue fee that paper fills do not pay. Call this immediately before place_trade: trades fill at the LIVE ask, which may differ from list data.

contracts.description: Size you are weighing; adds estimated_cost_dollars and venue_fee_est_dollars for both sides. Any whole number up to 1,000,000,000, the most one trade can record.

ref.description: The same as ticker: a Kalshi ticker, an instrument id or an Arena slug.

ticker.description: A Kalshi ticker from list_markets or search_markets, or an instrument id (ins_...) or Arena slug. ref is the same argument.

name: get_market
title: Quote one market
